cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario returning --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40. start in src/bin/jackin/app.rs attaches only Scenario::CapsuleMulti and Scenario::OutroLast, so returning opens the manager. ManagerScreen starts on Current directory. Down reaches payments-platform, Right expands it, and Down selects the row whose id is painted by trim_start_matches("jk-") in src/bin/jackin/screens/manager.rs, so the focused row contains 7f3a. Enter attaches that instance. CapsuleScreen::hints in src/bin/jackin/screens/capsule.rs paints Ctrl+\ for Palette, and CapsuleScreen::on_key opens the palette on KeyCode::Char('\\') with ctrl. Typing export file calls refresh_picker in src/bin/jackin/app.rs, which sets the palette scope to "{n} of 20". Picker::set_items in src/widgets/picker.rs resets the cursor to first_enabled. palette_items disables the under-cursor rows, so the first enabled match is Export file. Enter calls run_palette, which opens Dialog::prompt in src/widgets/dialog.rs titled Export file, with placeholder "workspace path or /jackin/run/…", help "Copies to ~/Downloads/jackin/ on the host", and tag export. The empty dialog shows that prompt and Exported to stays absent. Tab moves focus to Cancel. Enter is Dialog action Some(0). The cancel arm in on_layer_result does not call finish_export. The capsule returns with payments-platform › the-architect, the process stays running, and You were in the Construct stays absent. --frame is not used.
cases.entry_path: jackin --scenario returning --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40, attach the 7f3a row, Ctrl+\, type export file, Enter
cases.return_path: Tab to Cancel and Enter closes the empty export dialog and returns to the capsule; the process stays there

cases.disposition_reason: finish_export in src/bin/jackin/screens/capsule.rs rejects an empty path with "Enter a path", a path containing ".." or starting with "/etc" with "Export failed: path is outside the workspace", and a path ending in "/" with "Export failed: is a directory". The path "cancel" sets "Export cancelled" and returns before any success string. Any other path sets the status to "Exported to ~/Downloads/jackin/payments-platform/{path}" with a leading slash trimmed, then appends " · revealed in Finder" or " · opened on host" only when export_kind says so. run_palette sets export_kind to (false, false) for the palette item Export file and opens Dialog::prompt in src/widgets/dialog.rs. Enter in that Immediate field finishes Dialog action Some(1), the primary button. on_layer_result calls finish_export with the field text. Confirming /etc/passwd shows "Export failed: path is outside the workspace" and "Exported to" stays absent. The checkpoint types notes/j06-marker.txt into that dialog before confirm and before cancel, at 120×40 and after resize(80, 24). Both frames contain notes/j06-marker.txt and lack "Exported to". resize(120, 40) restores the wide dialog. Tab then Enter is action Some(0), which does not call finish_export, so the success report stays absent. That cancel does not type the path "cancel". A separate launch confirms notes/j06-marker.txt. The status is exactly "Exported to ~/Downloads/jackin/payments-platform/notes/j06-marker.txt" and does not contain the outside-workspace error, "Enter a path", the directory error, "Export cancelled", "revealed in Finder", or "opened on host". That status is the whole report. The test does not claim a host file was written. --frame is not used.
cases.action_sequence: Enter an invalid path, cancel a valid path, and confirm a valid path.
cases.expected_results: Invalid is rejected. Cancel writes no success report. Confirm reports that path.
cases.forbidden_effects: The test claims a host file was written.
